posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Our approach to bioresilience Google DeepMind · 🔵 Gemini · 📣 Official · 1h ago • Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs are jointly sharing their approach to bioresilience and AI models. • Bioresilience focuses on building AI systems robust to biological and environmental challenges. • The partnership combines DeepMind's AI expertise with Isomorphic Labs' biological research capabilities. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Gemma 4 gets a stealth update that fixes tool calling bugs and truncated responses under the same name The Decoder · 🔵 Gemini · 2h ago • Google released a stealth update to Gemma 4 fixing tool calling bugs and truncated response issues. • Update improves performance on Nvidia Hopper GPUs without changing the model version number. • Changes address practical usability problems in the open-source AI model. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform xAI open-sources "Grok-Build" on GitHub after massive data breach The Decoder · ⚡ Grok · 3h ago • xAI's Grok-Build tool silently uploaded user directories including SSH keys and password databases to Google Cloud. • Elon Musk promised to delete all uploaded data after backlash from the security vulnerability. • xAI open-sourced the 844,530-line Rust codebase following the data breach disclosure. 📰 Also covered by: Simon Willison Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Mermaid to Unicode box art (grok-mermaid) Simon Willison · ⚡ Grok · 10h ago • Simon Willison discovered a self-contained terminal renderer for Mermaid diagrams in the open-sourced Grok codebase. • The tool converts Mermaid diagrams to Unicode box art for command-line display. • The Rust implementation was found while exploring xAI's newly public CLI agent code. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform xAI sues a man for using Grok to generate CSAM ‘deepfakes’ The Verge – AI · ⚡ Grok · 13h ago • xAI is suing a South Carolina man for allegedly using Grok to generate child sexual abuse material. • The lawsuit claims the user knowingly circumvented xAI's safety measures. • Case highlights liability concerns for AI companies when tools are misused for illegal content generation. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry Pay.UK appoints executives from Monzo, Equals and Bank of Ireland UK to join Board Finextra · just now • Pay.UK appointed three non-executive directors from Monzo, Equals, and Bank of Ireland UK effective July 2026. • Board expansion brings fintech expertise to the UK interbank payment systems operator. • Appointments strengthen Pay.UK's industry leadership across retail payments and banking. 🌐 AI Industry PayPal launches Pay in 30 days for UK shoppers Finextra · just now • PayPal launched Pay in 30 Days in the UK offering interest-free installment payments with no fees. • Service targets millions of UK shoppers seeking flexible payment options at checkout. • Program expands PayPal's buy-now-pay-later offerings in the UK market. Read more →

🌐 AI Industry Remitly granted stored value licence by the Central Bank of the UAE Finextra · just now • Remitly obtained a Stored Value Facilities Category IV licence from the Central Bank of the UAE. • License enables Remitly to offer new financial products to UAE customers. • Recognition follows months of regulatory groundwork in the region. 🌐 AI Industry COMPUTER COPS: Inside the big business of selling AI to the police The Verge – AI · 28m ago • Police departments are increasingly adopting AI tools presented as the future of law enforcement. • Major industry event in Fort Worth, Texas showcased AI solutions for policing. • Article examines the commercial market for AI systems in criminal justice and law enforcement. 🌐 AI Industry TSMC pledges extra US$100 billion for Arizona fab expansion amid soaring AI chip demand SCMP – Tech · 🌏 Asia · 58m ago • TSMC pledged an additional $100 billion for Arizona fab expansion, bringing total US investment to $265 billion. • Expansion driven by surging AI chip demand requiring increased semiconductor manufacturing capacity. • Investment strengthens TSMC's US production footprint amid global chip demand surge.
